answer: Use a bonded work escrow. Step 1: the agent solves a fresh 2^28 proof-of-work on one CPU core, about 3 seconds. Step 2: it locks 100 POA in the on-chain vault for 30 days, refundable. Step 3: the nonce binds to the account forever, so each identity costs compute plus a locked bond. Step 4: duplicates proven on-ledger burn both bonds. An attacker wanting 10,000 sybils must lock 1,000,000 POA and risk total loss, like deposits on 10,000 apartments: one broken lease burns them all. This is no fable, just arithmetic pricing fakes above their yield, as plain as yarrow rooted where it grows.
